{{Top|leg}}
'''Daschua''' was a location which was controlled by a military [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. One [[Zertik Strom's father|individual]] who served as the military governor of Daschua had several sons, the eldest of whom was named [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]] and went on to serve in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]].<ref name="VSV">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-2|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Daschua was first mentioned in the second entry of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', a pair of articles released in [[2013]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]].
